scores.evidence: The layered-defence flowchart (s2-layers) fits in a top-down column at 390 px and its Japanese labels can be read (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, -07.png). Both tables (s2-table, s5-table) keep two readable columns on mobile, and every code block (s3-code, practice-case-*, practice-folder, practice-answer-rule) shows whole lines with no clipping (pages/mobile-jp-10.png, -15.png, -17.png, -18.png).

metrics.json lists no text-only screens. Every section switches between prose, a definition list, a table or code and a check. The prerequisites line under the title is a dense five-line run of small text on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-01.png). The practice section stacks three separate one-step step lists, each with its own '1ステップ中 0 完了' header (pages/mobile-jp-16.png, -18.png).

All visible lesson text and the diagram labels are Japanese, with English terms only in parentheses, and contrast is good on every screen. Inline code chips stay whole on mobile and nothing is hidden under the top or bottom bars (pages/mobile-jp-11.png, -21.png). There is no untranslated or mixed-language text.

niceToHave: s3-check (q3, options a and d): at 390 px only the last kana 'く' of 'を書く' wraps onto a line by itself after the code chip (pages/mobile-jp-11.png, -12.png). Shortening the options to 'deny に Write(./certs/**)' and 'deny に Read(./certs/**)' and moving 'を書く' into the question would keep each option on one line.

practice-steps / practice-steps-deny / practice-steps-bill: three step lists in a row, each holding one step, repeat the '手順 1ステップ中 0 完了' header (pages/mobile-jp-16.png, -18.png). Consider merging them into one 3-step list, or turning the single steps into md plus the prompt blocks.

lesson: the prerequisites line under the title runs to five lines of small grey text on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-01.png). A shorter list, for example lesson numbers only, would lighten the first screen.
reader: desktop JP charsPerLine median is 44 against a target of 30–40 (measure 680 px at 18.7 px). This comes from the reader's column width, not from the lesson.

summary: metrics.json shows no hard failures: no overflow, no console, mermaid or image errors, no unknown blocks and no text-only screens. No screen shows personal data. At 390 px the flowchart, both two-column tables and every code block stay readable and nothing is cut off. Only small polish is left: one kana wraps alone in the q3 options, and the practice section has three one-step step lists that could be merged.
